author: Universal Pictures
description:
Greg Focker (Ben Stiller) desperately tries to impress his partner's, Pam (Teri Polo), father Jack (Robert De Niro). Jack, suspicious of Greg, continuously searches for the truth. From performing a lie detector test, to giving him a truth serum, all the way to stalking him while he goes to a work event, Jack excludes Greg from his "Circle of trust".
